$comment: Three residents (vertical slice design §3, §4-2). wake/sleep are minutes after the life day starts at my 05:00 (30 = 05:30, 1110 = 23:30, 1200 = 01:00 next morning). offWeekday: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday. habitSleep/habitWake apply only when the village keeps that visit-band habit (§10-3, W6). home is where the resident appears at waking and leaves at sleep. multipliers are per-mille personality multipliers on the base score (§3); crowdedRest applies to resting at a cafe seat while customers wait.
